```yaml
name: Auto Approve Copilot Workflows

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Check for schema coverage
        run: |
          go run internal/tools/check_schema_coverage/main.go \
            --schema-file internal/elasticsearch/index/index/schema.go \
            --acceptance-tests internal/elasticsearch/index/index/acc_test.go

      - name: Approve PR if schema coverage is complete
        if: ${{ success() }}
        run: echo "PR approved due to complete schema coverage"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
